fix_summary.defect_1_native_exit_handling: schtasks /delete of a not-yet-existent temp task under $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' is promoted to a terminating error on Windows PowerShell 5.1; the $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference guard is PS7.3+-only and inert on 5.1. Fix: every schtasks call routes through Invoke-Schtasks, which scopes $ErrorActionPreference='Continue' and reads $LASTEXITCODE (robust on 5.1 and 7.4+); Remove-TempTask makes missing-task cleanup a no-op; no 2>$null remains.
fix_summary.defect_2_principal_derivation: The principal was derived from the current user's domain/name, which over SSH was WORKGROUP\administrator - unmappable to a SID, so schtasks rejected otherwise-valid XML. Fix: an explicit -Principal parameter is REQUIRED and SID-verified via NTAccount.Translate BEFORE any task is created; fail closed (exit 2) with NO current-user fallback.
fix_summary.proof_sequence: ParseFile all reviewed .ps1 + positive control; corrected template XML accepted; installer-generated XML accepted; readback disabled + triggerless + no RestartOnFailure + no HighestAvailable; PT0M rejected (negative control); temp task deleted and absent. Non-production task name; self-cleans on success and failure.
